001package org.clafer.ir.analysis;
002
003import java.util.HashSet;
004import java.util.Set;
005import org.clafer.collection.Pair;
006import org.clafer.ir.IrBoolExpr;
007import org.clafer.ir.IrCompare;
008import org.clafer.ir.IrIntExpr;
009import org.clafer.ir.IrModule;
010import org.clafer.ir.Irs;
011
012/**
013 * Remove constraints that are duplicated. One example is to remove weaker
014 * constraints that are already enforced by stronger ones. Another example is
015 * due to coalescing, it is possible to end up with multiple cardinality
016 * variables for the same set. Remove the duplicates.
017 *
018 * @author jimmy
019 */
020public class DuplicateConstraints {
021
022    private DuplicateConstraints() {
023    }
024
025    /**
026     * Reduce.
027     *
028     * <ol>
029     * <li>a = b & a ≤ b to a = b</li>
030     * <li>a ≠ b & a &lt; b to a &lt; b</li>
031     * <li>a ≠ b & a ≤ b to a &lt; b</li>
032     * <li>a &lt; b & a ≤ b to a &lt; b</li>
033     * <li>a ≤ b & b ≤ a to a = b</li>
034     * </ol>
035     *
036     * @param module the module to remove duplicates
037     * @return the optimized module
038     */
039    public static IrModule removeDuplicates(IrModule module) {
040        HashSet<Pair<IrIntExpr, IrIntExpr>> equal = new HashSet<>();
041        HashSet<Pair<IrIntExpr, IrIntExpr>> notEqual = new HashSet<>();
042        HashSet<Pair<IrIntExpr, IrIntExpr>> lessThanEqual = new HashSet<>();
043        HashSet<Pair<IrIntExpr, IrIntExpr>> lessThan = new HashSet<>();
044
045        Set<IrBoolExpr> constraints = new HashSet<>(module.getConstraints().size());
046
047        for (IrBoolExpr constraint : module.getConstraints()) {
048            if (constraint instanceof IrCompare) {
049                IrCompare compare = (IrCompare) constraint;
050                IrIntExpr left = compare.getLeft();
051                IrIntExpr right = compare.getRight();
052                Pair<IrIntExpr, IrIntExpr> pair = new Pair<>(left, right);
053                Pair<IrIntExpr, IrIntExpr> converse = new Pair<>(right, left);
054
055                switch (compare.getOp()) {
056                    case Equal:
057                        lessThanEqual.remove(pair);
058                        lessThanEqual.remove(converse);
059                        equal.add(pair);
060                        equal.remove(converse);
061                        break;
062                    case NotEqual:
063                        if (lessThanEqual.remove(pair)) {
064                            lessThan.add(pair);
065                        } else if (lessThanEqual.remove(converse)) {
066                            lessThan.add(converse);
067                        } else if (!lessThan.contains(pair)
068                                && !lessThan.contains(converse)) {
069                            notEqual.add(pair);
070                            notEqual.remove(converse);
071                        }
072                        break;
073                    case LessThanEqual:
074                        if (notEqual.remove(pair)) {
075                            lessThan.add(pair);
076                        } else if (notEqual.remove(converse)) {
077                            lessThan.add(converse);
078                        } else if (lessThanEqual.remove(converse)) {
079                            equal.add(pair);
080                        } else if (!equal.contains(pair)
081                                && !equal.contains(converse)
082                                && !lessThan.contains(pair)) {
083                            lessThanEqual.add(pair);
084                        }
085                        break;
086                    default:
087                        throw new IllegalStateException();
088                }
089            } else {
090                constraints.add(constraint);
091            }
092        }
093
094        for (Pair<IrIntExpr, IrIntExpr> p : equal) {
095            constraints.add(Irs.equal(p.getFst(), p.getSnd()));
096        }
097        for (Pair<IrIntExpr, IrIntExpr> p : notEqual) {
098            constraints.add(Irs.notEqual(p.getFst(), p.getSnd()));
099        }
100        for (Pair<IrIntExpr, IrIntExpr> p : lessThan) {
101            constraints.add(Irs.lessThan(p.getFst(), p.getSnd()));
102        }
103        for (Pair<IrIntExpr, IrIntExpr> p : lessThanEqual) {
104            constraints.add(Irs.lessThanEqual(p.getFst(), p.getSnd()));
105        }
106
107        return new IrModule().addConstraints(constraints);
108    }
109}
